## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the user-visible problem, the fix, and any package/data compatibility implications.

## Validation

- Commands and results:
- Environment (host, simulated Android, or actual head unit):
- Checks not run and why:

## Quality evidence

Targets: maintainability index >60; line coverage >=85%; branch coverage >=85%. Report Java and Python separately, including baseline, resulting values, scope, and tool versions. These targets are not fully enforced by current CI. Identify unmeasured values or unmet targets explicitly; do not substitute a passing build or combined coverage percentage.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Meaningful regression tests added where behavior changed.
- [ ] Existing tests pass; limitations are stated above.
- [ ] Docs match changed behavior.
- [ ] No secrets, user data, or generated outputs included.
- [ ] Release changes, if any, cover failed checks, exact commit tagging, collisions, reruns, and notes.

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/hmason55/nemesis-package-manager/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for the full standards.
